description: Derived from AGSC-05-36: `export --skos` writes one Turtle file of the published projection with its own two-line prefix block. It copies the SKOS triples of the graph whose ends are in the view, and adds `a skos:ConceptScheme` for the Bundle, `a skos:Concept` for each concept and lesson, `a skos:Collection` for the cluster `grp`, `skos:hasTopConcept` and `skos:topConceptOf` for each concept with no `skos:broader` (`alpha`, `gamma` and the lesson `les`; `beta` has a broader), and the scheme record from `site.title`, `site.tagline`, `site.author` and `bundle.license_prose`. The episode `ep` is not a SKOS concept: it and the `skos:member` triple that names it are left out. The cluster has no `skos:inScheme`, because the graph gives none to a Collection. The stable-Turtle ordering of AGSC-05-10 applies, so the type of a Collection sorts before its other predicates and the dcterms predicates of the scheme sort before its type.
